findings.issue: AppLog.swift exposes os.Logger values directly (AppLog.scraper is a Logger, not a closure or wrapper). The injectable logging closure seam described in the TDD anchor (test_noCookieValueAppearsInCapturedLogSink) requires the implementer to add a seam that the existing AppLog type does not provide. The task correctly states 'Provide the seam — leave the exact mechanism to the implementer', so this is an implementation responsibility rather than a task contradiction.
findings.fix: No change required to the task. Confirm at code-review time that the chosen seam (e.g. an injectable closure defaulting to a no-op or an AppLog-wrapping closure) compiles under strict concurrency (Sendable closure or actor-isolated).
